subject: dryer lint filter
title: What If You Never Cleaned Your Dryer Lint Filter?

scenes.text: What if you never cleaned your dryer's lint filter? That soft grey fluff is fuel.
Every load sheds fibers from your clothes. Skip the screen for weeks, and they start choking the dryer's airflow.
Lint burns easily. It's the first thing to catch fire in about 28 percent of US home dryer fires.
And the top cause of those fires is failure to clean, behind roughly a third of them.
US fire departments answer about 2,900 home clothes dryer fires every year. January is the worst month.
Peel off that fluff after every load. The scariest lint is the part you can't see, deep in the vent.

description:
What if you never cleaned your dryer's lint filter? The US Fire Administration estimates about 2,900 home clothes dryer fires a year, peaking in January; failure to clean was the leading factor (34%), and dust, fiber and lint were the item first ignited in 28%.
NFPA and UL figures agree that failure to clean is the leading cause (29-33%). Lint also builds up in the vent and duct, which need cleaning too.
